business_invariants.statement: A TC import commits its BOP entries, independent socket/tool/fixture/equipment links and unresolved-resource staging rows completely or not at all.
TC socket, tool, fixture and equipment requirements remain separate BOP node and link types.

descriptors.do_not_use_when: The request creates/copies/imports entries, changes links only, or operates on staging.

Delete retires the entry and its active entry links in one Craft transaction without leaving visible dangling relationships.

descriptors.side_effects: Reads craft domain state; emits no mutation event or external call.

descriptors.title: craft.bop.picture.upload
descriptors.description: Upload a bounded image asset for BOP picture references.
descriptors.use_when: A governed Craft consumer uploads an image used by a BOP entry or process view.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The request changes BOP entities, links, or metadata, or uploads non-image artifacts.
descriptors.business_effect: Store one bounded image and return its governed URL for later attachment to a BOP entry or process view.
business_acceptance_criteria: The accepted payload is an image MIME type whose decoded content does not exceed five megabytes.
A successful result contains one URL conforming to the closed upload-result contract.
Invalid filenames, MIME types or base64 content return a governed error without reporting an uploaded asset.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: This capability stores an image asset but does not itself attach or mutate any BOP business entity.
descriptors.side_effects: Writes craft domain state through its Provider and records a capability audit event.

descriptors.title: craft.bop.work_package.get
descriptors.description: Project one BOP structure into a line, station or role work package.
descriptors.use_when: The caller needs bounded execution context for one governed scope.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The caller needs the complete BOP structure.
descriptors.business_effect: Return one bounded page of BOP work-package nodes with reference summaries for a governed line, station or role scope.
business_acceptance_criteria: Every returned node belongs to the requested BOP version, revision and work-package scope.
A page contains at most 200 nodes and returns an opaque continuation cursor when more nodes exist.
Entity summaries expose only allowlisted fields and the work-package read does not mutate domain records.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: This read projects existing governed BOP records; scope, pagination and field allowlisting are enforced by its repository and closed contract.
descriptors.side_effects: Reads craft domain state; emits no mutation event or external call.

descriptors.use_when: A consumer needs lightweight nodes and references for one BOP scope.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: A consumer needs the complete BOP or a role projection from version 1.
descriptors.business_effect: Return one bounded page of BOP work-package nodes with reference summaries for a governed line, station or role scope.
business_acceptance_criteria: Every returned node belongs to the requested BOP version, revision and work-package scope.
A page contains at most 200 nodes and returns an opaque continuation cursor when more nodes exist.
Entity summaries expose only allowlisted fields and the work-package read does not mutate domain records.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: This read projects existing governed BOP records; scope, pagination and field allowlisting are enforced by its repository and closed contract.
descriptors.side_effects: Reads craft domain state; emits no mutation event or external call.

descriptors.description: Apply bounded, audited changes to Craft manufacturing resource library records.
descriptors.use_when: A governed Craft consumer needs to create, update, retire, delete or reconcile library records.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The change belongs to BOP, PBOM, GBOP or another domain capability.
descriptors.business_effect: Create or change manufacturing-resource library records, including one governed VPPS part-name batch import.
business_acceptance_criteria: A VPPS part-name import accepts at most 10000 records and requires a non-empty VPPS identifier for creation.
Existing, duplicate and blank VPPS identifiers are skipped and counted without overwriting governed master data.
Created and skipped counts reconcile the complete input batch.
A database failure rolls back the complete batch rather than leaving a partial import.

business_invariants.statement: A VPPS part-name import batch is committed completely or not at all.
Created and skipped counts reconcile every supplied VPPS part-name row exactly once.

descriptors.side_effects: Writes craft domain state through its Provider and records a capability audit event.

descriptors.title: craft.standard_operation.change.apply
descriptors.description: Apply bounded Craft standard operation lifecycle and content changes.
descriptors.use_when: A governed consumer needs to create, update, publish, deprecate or delete a standard operation.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The change belongs to a GBOP release or BOP execution operation.
descriptors.business_effect: Create or change standard operations, including one governed batch import whose conflict policy and result counts are explicit to the caller.
business_acceptance_criteria: A bulk import accepts between 1 and 10000 records and requires a non-empty code and name for every record.
The skip, overwrite and append conflict policies produce their declared create, update and skip outcomes.
The created, updated and skipped counts reconcile the complete input batch.
A database failure rolls back the complete batch rather than leaving a partial import.

business_invariants.statement: A standard-operation import batch is committed completely or not at all.
Created, updated and skipped counts reconcile every supplied standard-operation record exactly once.

descriptors.side_effects: Writes craft domain state through its Provider and records a capability audit event.

descriptors.use_when: A governed consumer needs VPPS operation audit history or Rule4 ignore state.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The request changes PBOM content itself.
descriptors.business_effect: Return bounded caller-visible PBOM VPPS audit history or Rule4 ignore state.
business_acceptance_criteria: Results belong only to the requested PBOM audit scope.
History and Rule4 state are returned through the published bounded output contract.
VPPS audit reads do not mutate audit or PBOM records.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: This read projects existing governed audit records and introduces no additional business-state decision.
descriptors.side_effects: Reads craft domain state; emits no mutation event or external call.

descriptors.title: device.connector.health.get
descriptors.description: Deprecated Connector compatibility identity.
descriptors.use_when: Never for new work; migrate to Simulation Connector capabilities.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: For every executable Connector or VisMockup operation.
descriptors.business_effect: Return the authenticated workstation's bounded AI00 Connector, user-session, adapter and target-application health projection.
business_acceptance_criteria: Health is returned only for the caller-owned device identity.
The projection identifies the bound user, interactive session and advertised Adapter contracts.
Reading health does not queue or execute local application work.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: This read reports already-recorded, caller-scoped Connector health and does not decide or mutate domain state.
descriptors.side_effects: Reads device domain state; emits no mutation event or external call.
descriptors.deprecation_message: Connector control moved to the Simulation domain; migrate to simulation.connector capabilities.

descriptors.title: device.connector.plan.queue
descriptors.description: Deprecated Connector compatibility identity.
descriptors.use_when: Never for new work; migrate to Simulation Connector capabilities.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: For every executable Connector or VisMockup operation.
descriptors.business_effect: Authenticate, validate and durably queue one exact signed execution plan for the bound user's AI00 Connector.
business_acceptance_criteria: The plan targets one caller-owned device and its bound user.
The queued payload retains the exact protocol, Adapter operation contracts and idempotency identity.
Rejected plans do not create executable local work.

business_invariants.statement: A Connector plan is queued only for the authenticated device and its single bound AI00 user.

descriptors.side_effects: Writes device domain state through its Provider and records a capability audit event.
